<description>
Picked from #35302 as an isolated change that can be evaluated independently. This should make #35302 a bit easier to review. This adds a Python implementation of BIP352 scanning, without labels, so the functional tests can check silent payments outputs independently of `bitcoind` support. It is tested against the BIP352 receiving test vectors.
</description>
